new_page.h1: Central Houses for Sale | Burnaby Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Central. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Central, Burnaby: 13 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 16 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Central rose from 10 in June to 13 in October (+30.0%), and 6 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 3.0% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Central?
Central also had 10 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in October, against 13 houses listed. The Central condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Central home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Central?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed in Central. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Central had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Central from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Central over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Central?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Central sell for?
faq.a: 7 houses sold in Central between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,650,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Central?
faq.a: The median was 13 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.3% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
